title: Math Material — Malta Lotto Quaterno: Combinations and Expected Value
question: How many Quaterno tickets are there, how many win in each prize tier for a given draw, and what is one ticket worth on average?
intro:
Malta Lotto draws 5 numbers from 1 to 90. A Quaterno ticket costs €3 and picks 4 numbers.

| Numbers matched | Prize |
|---|---:|
| 2 of 4 | €25 |
| 3 of 4 | €475 |
| 4 of 4 | €501,750 |

questions.title: Number of combinations
questions.prompt: How many different combinations of 4 numbers can a player pick?
steps:
The order of the 4 numbers does not matter, so count combinations:

\[
N=\binom{90}{4}=\frac{90!}{4!\,86!}
\]

questions.title: Winning combinations
questions.prompt: The draw is 17, 73, 40, 80 and 9. How many winning combinations match all four numbers?
steps:
A ticket matches all four when its 4 numbers are 4 of the 5 drawn numbers:

\[
\binom54=\boxed{5}
\]

questions.title: Tickets in each prize tier
questions.prompt: How many tickets match exactly 2, exactly 3 and all 4 numbers?
steps:
A ticket with \(k\) matches takes \(k\) of the 5 drawn numbers and \(4-k\) of the 85 other numbers:

\[
\binom5k\binom{85}{4-k}
\]

questions.title: Expected value
questions.prompt: What is the expected value of one ticket?
steps:
Each prize tier contributes its probability times its prize, with \(P_i=\dfrac{\text{tickets}_i}{N}\):

\[
E=\sum_i P_i\,W_i
\]
